node.title: Re^3: match digit, followed by hyphen, followed again by digit - then add whitespaces and replace in file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
However the output now needs further formatting as it's printed with brackets etc. I tried adding a print statement but dd still prints everything.

You can print @cols any way you want, using a regular [doc://print] or [doc://printf], instead of [mod://Data::Dump], which is just a debugging aid. If you could show what code you are trying and what output format you expect, we could help better ([id://174051]). Also, note I updated my node right around the time you replied, check out the update too.
